verdict.rationale: Drata documents a versioned public API: the developer portal markets "Public APIv2", and its reference lives under a /v2/ path, so explicit API versioning exists. Nothing in the pack documents a deprecation policy, sunset timelines, or v1-to-v2 migration guidance, so only half the story is shown. Missing for 10: a documented deprecation policy, deprecation and sunset timelines, a changelog or migration guide, and independent corroboration of version stability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
